result.rationale: The Watch band is defensible as a monitoring flag, but it rests almost entirely on one news item: the news component contributes 20.6 of the 28.4 points, while the payment side contributes only 7.8 (0.65 x 12.0 at 12 DPD). Strip out the single severity-3 article and the score falls to 7.8, well inside Healthy, so the band placement is wholly dependent on a source whose stored body text is just a repetition of the headline and which describes a minister asking officials to blacklist rather than an executed debarment. Separately, the payment notification and the payment agent's review of that same notification disagree materially on the amount owed, which should be reconciled before this goes out. I would keep Watch for monitoring purposes, but the underwriter should treat the regulatory item as unverified and confirm the exposure figure.
